Create Forgery
Downtime, Secret
Requirements: You provide the proper writing materials for your forgery.
Typically takes a day or a week to complete. The GM makes a secret DC 20 Society check.
Success: The forgery is of good enough quality that passive observers can't notice the fake.
Failure: The forgery has some obvious signs of being a fake, potentially allowing passive observers to detect it; passive observers compare your result against their own Perception or Society DC.

Decipher Writing
Use this skill to Decipher Writing on general topics of civics and culture.

title: Stealth
text:
Key Attribute: Dexterity

You are skilled at avoiding detection, allowing you to slip past foes, hide, or conceal an item.

Untrained Actions

Conceal an Object [one-action]
Manipulate, Secret
You hide a small object on your person or elsewhere. The GM rolls your Stealth check against passive observers' Perception DC. Once the GM rolls your check for a concealed object, that same result is used no matter how many passive observers you try to sneak it past.
Success: The object remains undetected.
Failure: A searcher finds the object.

Hide [one-action]
Secret
You move behind cover or otherwise conceal yourself, attempting to go from observed to hidden. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus if you have standard cover (+4 with greater cover).
Success: You become hidden from the creature instead of observed.
You cease being hidden if you take any action other than Hide, Sneak, or Step.

Sneak [one-action]
Move, Secret
Stride up to half your Speed while remaining undetected. The GM rolls your Stealth check against the Perception DC of each creature you're moving past.
Success: You remain undetected.
Failure: You are hidden (rather than undetected) to the creature but your position is revealed.
Critical Failure: You are observed by the creature.

Note (mirror caveat, not part of the original text): this fetch found no distinct Trained Actions section for Stealth.

title: Survival
text:
Key Attribute: Wisdom

You are adept at living in the wilderness, foraging for food and building shelter, and with training you discover the secrets of tracking and hiding your trail.

Untrained Actions

Sense Direction
Exploration, Secret
Using the position of astronomical objects in the sky, traits of the geography or flora, or the behavior of fauna, you can stay oriented in the wild.
Critical Success: You get an excellent sense of where you are. If you are in an environment with cardinal directions, you know them exactly.
Success: You gain enough orientation to avoid becoming hopelessly lost.

Subsist
Downtime
Even untrained, you can Subsist by foraging for food and building shelter in the wilderness.

Trained Actions

Cover Tracks
Move, Concentrate, Exploration
You Stride up to half your travel Speed while covering your tracks as you go. You don't need to attempt a Survival check to cover your tracks, but anyone tracking you must succeed at a Survival check against your Survival DC (instead of the normal DC) if your Survival DC is higher.

Track
Move, Concentrate, Exploration
You move at half Speed while following a creature's tracks, needing to succeed at an initial Survival check and then can follow the trail for up to 1 hour without needing to attempt further checks.
Success: You find the trail or continue to follow the one you're already following.
Failure: You lose the trail but can try again after a 1-hour delay.
Critical Failure: You lose the trail and can't try again for 24 hours.

title: Thievery
text:
Key Attribute: Dexterity

Untrained Actions

Palm an Object [one-action]
Manipulate
You pick up a small, unattended object and try not to be noticed.
Success: The creature doesn't notice you Palming the Object.
Failure: The creature notices you Palming the Object.

Steal [one-action]
Manipulate
You try to take a small object from another creature without being noticed.
Success: You steal the item without the bearer noticing, or an observer doesn't see you.
Failure: The item's bearer notices your attempt before you can take the object, or an observer sees you.

Trained Actions

Disable a Device [two-actions]
Manipulate
This action allows you to disarm a trap or another complex device.
Critical Success: You disable the device, or achieve two successes toward disabling it. You leave no trace.
Success: You disable the device, or achieve one success toward disabling it.
Critical Failure: You trigger the device.

Pick a Lock [two-actions]
Manipulate
Requirements: You're holding or wearing an infiltrator's toolkit.
Critical Success: You unlock the lock, or achieve two successes toward unlocking it. You leave no trace of tampering.
Success: You open the lock, or achieve one success toward unlocking it. You leave behind evidence indicating picking.

title: Arcana
text:
Key Attribute: Intelligence

Arcana measures how much you know about arcane magic and creatures. Even if you're untrained, you can Recall Knowledge about arcane theories, magical traditions, creatures of arcane significance (magitech constructs, beasts, elementals), and planar knowledge.

Untrained Actions

Recall Knowledge [one-action]
Concentrate, Secret
Use this skill to Recall Knowledge about arcane theory, creatures related to arcane magic, and the arcane tradition of magic.

Trained Actions

Decipher Writing
Use this skill to Decipher Writing that relates to arcane theory.

Identify Magic
Use this skill to Identify Magic, particularly effects related to the arcane tradition.

Learn a Spell
Use this skill to Learn a Spell from the arcane tradition.

Borrow an Arcane Spell
Concentrate, Exploration
You can prepare a single spell from another spellcaster's arcane spellbook or list, integrating it into your own studies for the day, provided you have the capability to prepare spells from a repertoire or spellbook.
Success: You prepare the borrowed spell as part of your normal spell preparation.
Failure: You fail to prepare the spell, but the spell slot remains available for you to prepare a different spell. You can't try to borrow this spell again until the next time you prepare spells.

Note (mirror caveat, not part of the original text): this fetch did not return explicit Critical Success/Critical Failure entries for Borrow an Arcane Spell, nor explicit action-cost icons for the four trained actions beyond what's shown above; recorded as retrieved, not filled in from elsewhere.

title: Athletics
text:
Key Attribute: Strength

You are skilled in feats of physical prowess. You can use Athletics to Climb, Force Open sticky, stuck, or barred doors, portals, and various other objects, Grapple foes, high jump and long jump, Reposition creatures, Shove them, Swim, and Trip foes. If you're trained, you can also Disarm foes.

Untrained Actions

Escape [one-action]
Attack
You attempt to escape from being grabbed, immobilized, or restrained. Roll an Athletics check (or another appropriate check) against the DC of the effect holding you (or, in the case of being grabbed, the Fortitude or Athletics DC of the creature grabbing you, whichever is higher). If your success or failure would end the effect (as is usually the case), you can attempt to Escape.
Critical Success: You get free and remove the grabbed, immobilized, and restrained conditions imposed by your chosen target. You can then Stride up to 5 feet.
Success: You get free and remove the grabbed, immobilized, and restrained conditions imposed by your chosen target.
Critical Failure: You don't get free, and you can't attempt to Escape again until your next turn.

Climb [one-action]
Move
Requirements: You have at least one hand free.
You attempt to Climb up, down, or across a slope that's steep enough to require a Climb check (usually at least a 60-degree incline), or you attempt to Climb a wall or other vertical incline. You typically must succeed at a check to Climb at the start of your movement and every time you move a number of feet equal to your Speed during that movement (rounding down, to a minimum of 5 feet).
Critical Success: You move along the incline, increasing the maximum distance by 5 feet.
Success: You move along the incline.
Failure: You stay in place, unable to progress.
Critical Failure: You fall. If you began the climb on stable ground, you fall and land prone. Otherwise, you might fall a great distance, depending on the situation.

Force Open [one-action]
Attack
You attempt to pry open a stuck, locked, or barred door, window, or other object, usually by physically forcing it open. The GM sets the DC based on the item you're trying to Force Open.
Critical Success: You break the door, window, container, or gate open, and it gains the broken condition.
Success: You open the door, window, container, or gate and can avoid damaging it in the process.
Failure: You fail to force the item open.
Critical Failure: Your attempt jams the door, window, container, or gate shut, imposing a -2 circumstance penalty on future attempts to Force it Open or otherwise open it (such as via Thievery).

Grapple [one-action]
Attack
Requirements: You have at least one free hand and your target is no more than one size larger than you.
You attempt to grab or wrestle with a foe, typically to prevent it from moving away or to keep it from acting effectively. Attempt an Athletics check against the target's Fortitude DC.
Critical Success: Your target is restrained until the end of your next turn unless you move or your target Escapes.
Success: Your target is grabbed until the end of your next turn unless you move or your target Escapes.
Failure: You fail to grab your target. If you already had the target grabbed or restrained using a Grapple, those conditions on the target end.
Critical Failure: If you already had the target grabbed or restrained, it breaks free, and it can then either automatically move you up to 5 feet or knock you prone.

High Jump [two-actions]
Requirements: You Stride or otherwise move at least 10 feet in a straight line right before attempting this action.
You attempt a vertical Leap. Attempt an Athletics check.
Critical Success: You Leap up to 8 feet vertically and 10 feet horizontally.
Success: You Leap up to 5 feet vertically and 5 feet horizontally.
Failure: You Leap normally, as if using the Leap basic action, but can't Leap vertically higher than 3 feet regardless of your roll.
Critical Failure: You fall prone in your space.

Long Jump [two-actions]
Requirements: You Stride or otherwise move at least 10 feet in a straight line right before attempting this action.
You attempt to make a horizontal Leap. Attempt an Athletics check to see how far you Leap.
Critical Success: You Leap up to a distance equal to your check result rounded down to the nearest 5 feet.
Success: You Leap up to a distance equal to your check result rounded down to the nearest 5 feet, but no more than double your Speed.
Failure: You make a normal horizontal Leap.
Critical Failure: You make a normal horizontal Leap, then fall and land prone.

Reposition [one-action]
Attack
Requirements: You either have at least one hand free, or you're grabbing or restraining the target. The target can't be more than one size larger than you.
Attempt an Athletics check against the target's Fortitude DC to move it from one space to another.
Critical Success: You move the creature up to 10 feet. It must remain within your reach during this movement, and you can't move it into or through obstacles.
Success: You move the target up to 5 feet. It must remain within your reach during this movement, and you can't move it into or through obstacles.
Failure: You don't move the target.
Critical Failure: The target can move you up to 5 feet as though it successfully Repositioned you.

Shove [one-action]
Attack
Requirements: You have at least one hand free. The target can't be more than one size larger than you.
You attempt to push a creature back. Attempt an Athletics check against the target's Fortitude DC.
Critical Success: You push your target up to 10 feet away from you. You can Stride after it, but you must move the same distance and in the same direction.
Success: You push your target back 5 feet. You can Stride after it, but you must move the same distance and in the same direction.
Failure: You fail to push the target back.
Critical Failure: You lose your balance, fall, and land prone.

Swim [one-action]
Move
You move through water or another liquid using a swimming stroke of your choice. You typically must succeed at a check to Swim at the start of your movement and every time you move a number of feet equal to your Speed during that movement (rounding down, to a minimum of 5 feet).
Critical Success: You move through the water, increasing the maximum distance by 5 feet.
Success: You move through the water.
Failure: You stay in place, unable to progress.
Critical Failure: You make no progress. If you're holding your breath, you lose 1 round of air.

Trip [one-action]
Attack
Requirements: You have at least one hand free. Your target can't be more than one size larger than you.
You attempt to knock a foe down. Attempt an Athletics check against the target's Fortitude DC.
Critical Success: The target falls, lands prone, and takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage.
Success: The target falls and lands prone.
Failure: You fail to knock down the target.
Critical Failure: You lose your balance, fall, and land prone.

Trained Actions

Disarm [one-action]
Attack
Requirements: You have at least one hand free. The target can't be more than one size larger than you.
You attempt to knock an item out of a creature's grasp, dislodge an object, or otherwise remove a physically held or attached item from a creature or object. Attempt an Athletics check against the target's Fortitude DC (or another appropriate DC).
Critical Success: You knock the item out of the target's grasp. It falls to the ground in the target's space.
Success: You weaken your target's grasp on the item. Further attempts to Disarm the target of that item gain a +2 circumstance bonus, and the target takes a -2 circumstance penalty to attacks with the item or other checks requiring a firm grasp on the item.
Failure: You fail to dislodge or disarm the item.
Critical Failure: You lose your balance and become off-guard until the start of your next turn.

title: Computers
text:
Key Attribute: Intelligence

Untrained Actions

Access Infosphere
Concentrate, Exploration, Secret
Requirements: You are using a device with infosphere access.
Critical Success: You find the information you were searching for. If this was used on a topic you could have used Recall Knowledge on, you instead find this information in 1 minute.
Success: You find the information you were looking for.
Failure: You find misleading information thanks to incorrect data or online pranksters.
Critical Failure: As failure.

Operate Device
Concentrate, Exploration
Requirements: You are using a computer or similar device.
Critical Success: You excel at what you are doing, learning secrets from the program or advanced functionality.
Success: You manage to operate the device in the necessary manner, including getting basic functionality.
Failure: You take a -2 circumstance penalty to further attempts for the next day.
Critical Failure: You are prevented from accessing the program for the next day.

Recall Knowledge [one-action]
Use this skill to Recall Knowledge about computer systems and technology.

Trained Actions

Decipher Writing
Use this skill to Decipher Writing that's encoded electronically.

Disable a Device [two-actions]
Manipulate
Source Player Core pg. 209 (Basic Actions chapter cross-reference).
Critical Success: You disable the device, or achieve two successes toward disabling.
Success: You disable the device, or achieve one success toward disabling.
Critical Failure: You trigger the device.

Hack
Exploration
Requirements: You have a hacking toolkit.
Source Player Core pg. 196.
Critical Success: You access the system, or achieve two successes toward accessing.
Success: You access the system, or achieve one success toward accessing.
Failure: You fail to access the system or achieve any success.
Critical Failure: You activate security protocols or lock yourself out for the next hour.

title: Crafting
text:
Key Attribute: Intelligence

Untrained Actions

Recall Knowledge [one-action]
Use this skill to Recall Knowledge about items and technology.

Repair
Exploration, Manipulate
Requirements: You are holding or wearing a repair toolkit.
Action cost: 10 minutes.
Critical Success: You restore 10 Hit Points to the item, plus an additional 10 HP per proficiency rank beyond trained.
Success: You restore 5 Hit Points to the item, plus an additional 5 HP per proficiency rank beyond trained.
Critical Failure: You deal 2d6 damage to the item.

Trained Actions

Craft
Downtime, Manipulate
Action cost: 2 days of setup (1 day if you have the item's formula).
Critical Success: Each additional day spent crafting reduces the raw materials needed based on your level + 1.
Success: Each additional day spent crafting reduces the raw materials needed based on your level.
Failure: You can salvage the raw materials you spent for their full value.
Critical Failure: You ruin 10% of the raw materials but can salvage the rest.

Earn Income
Downtime
Use this skill to Earn Income by practicing a trade.

title: Deception
text:
Key Attribute: Charisma

Untrained Actions

Create a Diversion [one-action]
Mental
With a gesture, a trick, or some distracting words, you can create a diversion that draws creatures' attention elsewhere, giving you a chance to Hide, Sneak, or otherwise slip away unnoticed. Attempt a Deception check against the Perception DC of each creature you're trying to divert.
Success: You become hidden to each creature whose Perception DC is less than or equal to your result.
Failure: You don't divert the attention of any creatures whose Perception DC exceeds your result.

Impersonate
Concentrate, Exploration, Manipulate, Secret
You create a disguise to pass yourself off as someone or something you are not.
Success: You trick the creature into thinking you're the person you're disguised as.
Failure: The creature can tell you're not who you claim to be.
Critical Failure: The creature can tell you're not who you claim to be, and it recognizes you.

Lie
Auditory, Concentrate, Linguistic, Mental, Secret
You try to fool someone with an untruth. Attempt a Deception check against the target's Perception DC.
Success: The target believes your lie.
Failure: The target doesn't believe your lie and gains a +4 circumstance bonus against your attempts to Lie to it for the rest of the conversation.

Trained Actions

Feint [one-action]
Mental
Requirements: You are within melee reach of the target you attempt to Feint.
You attempt to trick your target in melee combat and set them up to be more vulnerable to your attacks. Attempt a Deception check against the target's Perception DC.
Critical Success: The target is off-guard against melee attacks that you attempt against it until the end of your next turn.
Success: The target is off-guard against the next melee attack that you attempt against it before the end of your current turn.
Failure: You don't trick your target.
Critical Failure: You are off-guard against melee attacks the target attempts against you until the end of your next turn.

title: Diplomacy
text:
Key Attribute: Charisma

You influence others through negotiation and flattery, or find out information through friendly chats.

Untrained Actions

Gather Information
Exploration, Secret
You canvass local markets, taverns, and gathering places in an attempt to learn about a specific individual or topic.
Success: You collect information about the individual or topic.
Critical Failure: You collect incorrect information about the individual or topic.

Make an Impression
Auditory, Concentrate, Exploration, Linguistic, Mental
Requirements: at least 1 minute of friendly conversation.
Attempt a Diplomacy check against the target's Will DC to improve its attitude toward you.
Critical Success: The target's attitude toward you improves by two steps.
Success: The target's attitude toward you improves by one step.
Critical Failure: The target's attitude toward you decreases by one step.

Request [one-action]
Auditory, Concentrate, Linguistic, Mental
You ask something of the target, attempting a Diplomacy check against its Will DC.
Critical Success: The target agrees to your request without qualifications.
Success: The target agrees to your request, though it might have limits or conditions.
Critical Failure: The target refuses your request, and its attitude toward you decreases by one step.

Note (mirror caveat, not part of the original text): this fetch found no distinct Trained Actions section for Diplomacy.

title: Intimidation
text:
Key Attribute: Charisma

Untrained Actions

Coerce
Auditory, Concentrate, Emotion, Exploration, Linguistic, Mental
You browbeat a creature, using the threat of violence or another undesirable outcome, to get it to answer a question or perform a simple task. This takes at least 1 minute of conversation, and the target must be able to understand you. Attempt an Intimidation check against the target's Will DC.
Critical Success: The target does what you ask and remains friendly to you after the fact, provided your requests were long as not extremely dangerous or against its nature; otherwise the target does what you ask but becomes unfriendly toward you once the effects of your Coerce action have ended.
Success: The target does what you ask, but becomes unfriendly toward you once the effects of your Coerce action have ended (or if it was already unfriendly or worse, its attitude worsens by one step).
Failure: The target doesn't do what you ask, and becomes unfriendly toward you if it wasn't already.
Critical Failure: The target doesn't do what you ask, becomes hostile toward you, and gains a +4 circumstance bonus to saves against your Coerce actions for 1 week.

Demoralize [one-action]
Auditory, Concentrate, Emotion, Fear, Mental
You attempt to frighten a creature within 30 feet by using verbal threats, a gesture, or another display of menace backed by a physical threat. If the target can't understand you or can't hear you, Demoralize doesn't work. Attempt an Intimidation check against the target's Will DC. You take a -4 circumstance penalty if you're trying to Demoralize a creature that doesn't understand your language, unless you're using purely visual means (in which case you take no penalty). Regardless of the outcome, you can't Demoralize the same creature again for 10 minutes.
Critical Success: The target becomes frightened 2.
Success: The target becomes frightened 1.
Failure: You fail to demoralize the target.
Critical Failure: You fail to demoralize the target and can't attempt to Demoralize it again for 1 hour.

title: Lore
text:
Key Attribute: Intelligence

You have specialized information on a narrow topic. Each Lore subcategory (for example, a specific field of study, organization, or region) counts as its own skill for the purpose of proficiency and skill increases. The GM determines which additional subcategories are permissible, with the constraint that a Lore subcategory cannot be so broad it would replace another Recall Knowledge skill. If there's any doubt whether a Lore skill applies to a specific topic or action, the GM decides whether it can be used or not.

Untrained Actions

Recall Knowledge [one-action]
Use this skill to Recall Knowledge about the subject of that Lore skill's subcategory.

Subsist
Downtime
Use this skill to Subsist, scraping by using your specialized knowledge.

Trained Actions

Earn Income
Downtime
Use this skill to Earn Income by practicing a trade related to your Lore subcategory.
